Google Ads API Developer Assistant v4.0.0

A major release of the Google Ads API Developer Assistant is now available. This release transitions the assistant from a standalone project setup to a unified plugin architecture designed to bring specialized Google Ads API capabilities directly into AI agent workflows. What is it? The Google Ads API Developer Assistant brings deep Google Ads domain expertise into AI coding environments like Antigravity and Claude Code.
